colombia.title: Flag of Colombia

colors.note: Represents wealth, sovereignty, and the sun
Represents the sky, seas, and rivers

desc: - Three horizontal stripes with yellow occupying the top half, and blue and red each taking a quarter
- Part of the Mirandine flag tradition inspired by Francisco de Miranda
trivia:
- The yellow stripe takes up half the flag by area, representing the nation's resources and optimism
- The colours represent blood (red), hope (yellow), and sovereignty (blue)
- Adopted in 1861; Colombia's flag inspired by the Gran Colombian flag of Simón Bolívar
